sections.introduction: Bhringamalakadi Thailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic preparation. This formulation helps in balancing Vata and Pittato relieve hair fall, baldness, graying of hairs. It is reputed in heat and aches in head. It is also useful to strengthen teeth, to improve vision etc.
sections.ingredients:
Bhringaraja (Eclipta alba) 
 Amalaki (Indian gooseberry fruit) 
 Sesame oil (Sesamum indicum) 
 Cow milk 
 Licorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra) 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Bhringamalalakadi Thailam is an Ayurvedic oil useful to manage the various problems. Application of this oil is very helpful to resolve the hair problems like hair fall, baldness, premature graying of hair. Use of this oil is also quite good to manage the various anti-inflammatory conditions like arthritis, back pain, sciatica etc. This is quite effective to alleviate the pains in rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, back pain etc. Besides of this, anti-arthritic properties of herbs used in this oil are very beneficial to resolve the various problems like swelling, joint pain, arthritic pain, morning stiffness etc. Application of Bhringamalakadi Thailam (oil), helps to improve the blood circulation in the affected areas. Besides of this, eye instillation of this oil is also good to clear the vision.
sections.indications:
Hair fall 
 Clear vision 
 Hair growth 
 Dental ailments 
 Back pain 
 Arthritis 
 Sciatica 
 Colicky pain 

 Method of Application 
 A generous amount of oil should be applied on the affected area and massaged properly.
sections.contraindications:
If this oil is prepared with coconut oil base then it may worsen symptoms of people suffering from sinusitis. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Bhringamalakadi Thailam (Oil) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasrayoga, Taila Prakarana 
 Introduction 
 Bhringamalakadi Thailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic preparation. This formulation helps in balancing Vata and Pittato relieve hair fall, baldness, graying of hairs. It is reputed in heat and aches in head. It is also useful to strengthen teeth, to improve vision etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Bhringaraja (Eclipta alba) 
 Amalaki (Indian gooseberry fruit) 
 Sesame oil (Sesamum indicum) 
 Cow milk 
 Licorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra) 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Bhringamalalakadi Thailam is an Ayurvedic oil useful to manage the various problems. Application of this oil is very helpful to resolve the hair problems like hair fall, baldness, premature graying of hair. Use of this oil is also quite good to manage the various anti-inflammatory conditions like arthritis, back pain, sciatica etc. This is quite effective to alleviate the pains in rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, back pain etc. Besides of this, anti-arthritic properties of herbs used in this oil are very beneficial to resolve the various problems like swelling, joint pain, arthritic pain, morning stiffness etc. Application of Bhringamalakadi Thailam (oil), helps to improve the blood circulation in the affected areas. Besides of this, eye instillation of this oil is also good to clear the vision. 
 Indications 
 
 Hair fall 
 Clear vision 
 Hair growth 
 Dental ailments 
 Back pain 
 Arthritis 
 Sciatica 
 Colicky pain 
 
 Method of Application 
 A generous amount of oil should be applied on the affected area and massaged properly. 
 Contraindications 
 If this oil is prepared with coconut oil base then it may worsen symptoms of people suffering from sinusitis. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
